The '''Dai Bendu language''' was spoken by the members of the ancient [[Order of Dai Bendu]] on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. The name of the [[Je'daii Order]] was forged in that [[Language/Legends|language]].

==Known words==
*''Dai'' - "Center."
*''Je'' - "Mystic."
*''[[Tho Yor]]'' - "One of the great pyramidal [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that carried the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] ancestors of the [[Je'daii Order]] to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]."
